notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on every entry.
There are no online trophies: all 55 are earned in single-player.
There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
Only one trophy is missable: Positive Mental Attitude, because one meditation spot (Lucia's balcony) is only reachable in Chapter 1.
Platinum time is roughly 200 hours, mostly long grinds rather than hard ones.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (roadmap, missable warning, 100% checklist)
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List (grades, counts, missable warning, no mission replay)
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements (list, hidden count, no online trophies)
Push Square — report of the PS5 list via Exophase, 18 Nov 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below: story first, then strangers and partners, then collectibles, then the activity grinds, and finally the 100% completion cleanup. On Xbox the same list exists as achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore, with no Platinum equivalent.
sources: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it pops at the mission-complete screen. It is the first story beat, so no preparation is needed — just play through the introduction as the game teaches you the basics.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete every mission of Chapter 1. Before you leave Chapter 1, finish the missable meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude — Lucia's balcony spot disappears once the chapter ends, and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter as insurance.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete every mission of Chapter 2. This is also the chapter where both protagonists become playable together, which opens up most partner activities and side content — use the chapter to try activities as they unlock rather than rushing straight through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete every mission of Chapter 3. Robbery trophies start opening up around this chapter, so as new robbery options appear, try them once — several later trophies (armored trucks, bank vaults, gang operations) build on mechanics introduced here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete every mission of Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before the final mission, make a manual save — the finale is the last point where a separate save lets you revisit the endgame state, and the final-mission gold trophy is earned here.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy, unmissable: finish the final mission and it pops with the credits. There is no difficulty requirement and no medal requirement attached to it, so play the finale at whatever pace and approach you prefer — the trophy only asks that you complete it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission trophies like this one unlock naturally as you follow the story — if it has not popped yet, you simply have not reached that mission, not missed it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story-gated, so this one arrives on the story's schedule. Use the heist to practise the robbery mechanics — vaults, escapes and wanted-level management — that the separate robbery trophies later demand.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it is tied to story progress alone — no side objective, collectible or score is needed for it to unlock.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Headliners. If you are tracking the story trophies in order, this one sits among the mid-story mission set — keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Note the airport itself matters for one more trophy — Catch Me If You Can asks for an unscheduled departure from VCIA — so once the airport is open to you, remember it as a location, not just a mission backdrop.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. This is the last of the named mid-story mission trophies — after it, the remaining story trophies are the chapter completions and the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy and the hardest one in the set: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist is a fixed set of tasks — story, strangers, collectibles, activities and the grinds in this guide — so work through it stage by stage instead of treating it as one grind. Use this tracker as your own copy of the checklist: when every other trophy here is ticked, the only things left for 100% are the checklist tasks with no trophy of their own, and the in-game stats page shows exactly which they are.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver grind: complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the stunt total the game tracks. Do it passively while travelling between missions instead of grinding it in one sitting: take jumps and fast routes everywhere and the count climbs on its own. Check the in-game stats page to see your running total and avoid repeating stunt types that no longer register.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting, shooting range and one more open-world activity the game counts. This is a sampler, not a grind: one attempt at each is enough, and failing an activity still counts as trying it. Work through the activities list in this guide and tick each type as you try it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver grind: gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so learn one weapon's recoil at a time and replay a challenge immediately while its layout is fresh in your mind. The range is repeatable with no entry cost to the trophy itself, so treat it as a late-game session: unlock the full weapon set first, then clear the challenges in batches.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about clean lines through the gates, not top speed — learn a course with a slow first run, then race it for the win. Locations unlock as you explore Leonida, so clear this one in the exploration stage: whenever you reach a new area, check whether it hosts a Top Fun race before moving on.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once, so replays of the same race do not help. Mix race types (street, off-road, boat, air) and pick a vehicle suited to each course rather than forcing one favourite car through everything. Races you already won for other trophies count here too, so this one usually pops while you are working through the activity list.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, not free fishing. Learn the fishing minigame first in open water (casting, reeling tension, keeping the line from snapping), then take on Cal: steady reeling beats frantic reeling, and a bigger catch wins the challenge. It pairs naturally with the opening mission's fishing lesson.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine, any title. Pick the shortest or simplest cabinet first; the trophy only asks for a completion, not a high score. Arcade machines are found in bars and arcades around Vice City, so this is a quick stop during the exploration stage.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Andy's mission chain through to its final mission. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as the story progresses — take them when they appear rather than leaving them all for the end, because later missions in a strand only unlock after the earlier ones. The trophy pops at the final mission's completion.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Kenton's mission chain through to its final mission. Kenton's strand involves boats and the waterways around Leonida, so keep a boat handy when his missions are active. As with every stranger strand, each mission unlocks the next — clear them in order as they appear.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Billy's mission chain through to its final mission. Billy's strand is bike-focused, so expect riding missions — a fast, stable bike helps more than raw speed. Complete his missions as they unlock to keep the strand moving alongside the story.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy: complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more strands the game offers. This is the umbrella trophy over the individual stranger finals, so it pops once your eighth strand is finished. The trick is coverage, not depth: start every stranger strand you find and finish each one, rather than replaying missions for a single character.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Randy's mission chain through to its final mission. Randy's strand revolves around supply runs, so plan for driving and delivery missions with a reliable vehicle. Finish his chain in order and the trophy pops at the final mission.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: finish Tyrone's mission chain through to its final mission. Tyrone's strand is tied to the DJ and club scene, so expect night-time city missions. As with the other strands, take each mission as it appears so the chain stays ahead of your story progress.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY in the game: meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. One spot — Lucia's balcony — is only reachable during Chapter 1 and disappears once that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay, so do it before finishing Chapter 1 or the trophy is locked for this playthrough. The other 17 spots stay available. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot as soon as you can, and then collect the remaining spots during exploration.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a stranger strand with a hunting target, not ordinary wildlife. Track the animal with the hunting mechanics (quiet approach, wind and scent, a clean shot) rather than chasing it through the brush. Bret's missions point you at the target; follow his strand and the hunt itself is the final step.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver collectible trophy: complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, interiors and hidden spots — and a set only counts when every card in it is found. Collect as you explore rather than hunting cards cold: grab any card you pass, and use the final stage to sweep the sets that are still short a card or two.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver grind: use the WAiNK app to scan 100 different locations. WAiNK scanning is the game's way of rewarding curiosity — point it at unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and spots as you travel. The fastest route is habit: scan everything new you pass during story and exploration, and the last stretch becomes a short sweep of unscanned districts rather than a 100-location chore.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's rotating set of small objectives, from stunt and driving feats to combat and exploration tasks. Challenges complete naturally while you play everything else, so check the challenges menu regularly and steer toward the ones closest to done. This trophy usually pops during the activity stage, not before it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. The reliable way is open ground and speed: get the heat in a fast car outside the city centre, then break line of sight, switch vehicles or hide until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner matters — a solo escape does not count — so trigger this during a partner free-roam session, not mid-mission.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — the streak breaks if the heat drops to zero between robberies. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the police at arm's length rather than fighting them. A quick car parked outside each shop makes the chain much easier.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — the game counts a vehicle as discovered when you drive or scan it, so variety beats repetition. Use the WAiNK app on unfamiliar vehicles and take a different car whenever you travel; traffic in each district leans toward different models. This pairs with You WAiNKer! and The Goodtime State in the exploration stage.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus (the slow-time aiming mode). Set it up where enemies cluster: enter a fight with a full Focus meter, wait until several enemies are in view, then trigger Focus and work through them quickly. A weapon with fast target switching helps, and missing shots wastes the window — aim for the group, not the stragglers.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA by air without a scheduled flight, for example by taking off in a plane yourself. Get to the airfield, find a flyable aircraft, and get airborne off the runway. The airport opens up through the story (see the Hi-Jacked mission), so try this once VCIA is accessible in free roam.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the game's tank, and this trophy is about surviving the heat it brings: get into a Rhino and ride out the wanted response it attracts. Expect heavy police attention — a tank draws it — so pick open ground, keep moving, and use the cannon on pursuing vehicles. The description is a joke about the heat; the unlock is the tank run itself.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, so no alarms, no spotted cameras, no witnesses calling it in. Scout the store first, learn the guard and camera pattern, and move quietly: a silenced approach and a fast, clean exit beat a loud smash-and-grab. If you are spotted, leave and try again rather than fighting through it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver robbery trophy: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the biggest robbery targets — plan the getaway before the break-in, with a fast car and a route out of the wanted zone. Each vault counts only if you escape cleanly, so treat the escape as half the job and do not linger for extra loot.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel set routes around the city — spot one, stop it (ramming or blocking works), crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. The robbery itself is quick; the escape is the test, so hit the truck near a route you already know.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district and region on the map. This is the exploration trophy: drive, fly and sail through the whole state, and watch the map fill in. Pair it with the WAiNK scans, vehicle discoveries and drone races, since all three reward the same travelling. The in-game map shows which areas are still undiscovered.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered — hit one per gang, not nine in total from the same crew. Learn which territory belongs to which gang as you explore, and clear this trophy district by district during the exploration stage.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet moment trophy, not a mission. Go to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; the trophy pops when the game registers the moment. It is one of the small flavour trophies best done early, while you are still learning the map.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass, the way the series' classic moments go. Pick a showroom, build speed outside, and drive through the front: the trophy is about the exit, so commit to it in one run rather than nudging the glass. Expect a wanted level afterwards and a getaway car waiting.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there and finish it. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one can share a visit. Aim for a full game, not a single frame, and the trophy pops at the follow-through.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a trophy about doing something memorable together with your partner, in front of a crowd. The description is deliberately vague, as hidden trophies are: play the partner activities and story beats that put the two of you in public, and it will unlock when the moment lands. No grind is attached to it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one, covering the choices you make across the game. There is no single trick to it: keep playing, keep choosing, and the count climbs with your decisions in missions, strangers and free roam. It is a late-game cleanup trophy, so check the tracked count in the stats page during the final stage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — a trophy that rewards retrying something after a first failure. The description gives nothing away, which is the point of a hidden trophy: it unlocks when an attempt that failed the first time succeeds on the second. Do not force it; play normally, retry what fails, and it will find you.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a trophy for witnessing something strange out in Leonida. The game hides odd encounters and events in the open world, and this one pops when you stumble into one. Explore off the beaten path — remote spots, odd hours, places with no mission marker — and keep an eye out for anything that does not belong.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. Pick a quiet street with few witnesses so the wanted level stays low, and use a slow vehicle — speed makes the timing harder, not easier.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — heists, vaults and armored trucks — and your contacts wash them into clean cash over time. Keep robbing and keep laundering: the total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so this trophy tracks your robbery career rather than one big score.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative spending on clothes, weapons, ammo, food and everything else the shops sell. Do not save it for the end: buy gear as you need it through the story and the total grows on its own. If you are short at cleanup time, stock up on ammo and weapon upgrades, which are the most useful way to close the gap.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money — buy each one when it appears rather than leaving them all for the end, since they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Check the property listings on the in-game phone whenever you have spare cash.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery and vehicle service. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or have discovered, and repeat until 10 are listed. It pairs with vehicle discovery: register the interesting cars you find instead of letting them go, and the trophy pops during the exploration stage.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
